title: In-Distribution Imagination for Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38673v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-based offline reinforcement learning (MBORL) improves sample efficiency through model-generated trajectories. However, accumulative model error can drive imagined trajectories outside the offline data distribution, leading to unrealistic synthetic data and unstable policy optimization. Many existing methods primarily control rollouts using transition-level uncertainty. We propose \emph{in-distribution imagination} (IDI), a rollout control framework that estimates trajectory support in a learned representation space and adaptively truncates rollouts that leave the offline trajectory manifold. Combined with trajectory-regularized RL, an extension of entropy-regularized RL, IDI consistently improves performance in limited-data settings. Experiments show that trajectory support predicts rollout failure substantially better than transition-level uncertainty, highlighting the importance of trajectory-level rollout control in MBORL.

translated_title: 面向基于模型的离线强化学习的分布内想象
translated_abstract: 基于模型的离线强化学习（MBORL）通过模型生成的轨迹来提升样本效率。然而，累积的模型误差可能使想象的轨迹偏离离线数据分布，导致不真实的合成数据和不稳定的策略优化。许多现有方法主要使用转移级别的不确定性来控制 rollout 推演。我们提出分布内想象（IDI），这是一种 rollout 控制框架，它在学习到的表示空间中估计轨迹支撑集，并自适应地截断偏离离线轨迹流形的 rollout。结合轨迹正则化强化学习（熵正则化强化学习的一种扩展），IDI 在数据有限的场景下能够持续提升性能。实验表明，轨迹支撑集对 rollout 失败的预测能力显著优于转移级不确定性，凸显了轨迹级 rollout 控制在 MBORL 中的重要性。
tldr: 提出分布内想象（IDI）框架，通过在学习表示空间中估计轨迹支撑并自适应截断偏离离线轨迹流形的 rollout，结合轨迹正则化强化学习，在数据有限场景下显著提升基于模型离线强化学习的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes In-Distribution Imagination (IDI), a rollout control framework that estimates trajectory support in a learned representation space and adaptively truncates rollouts leaving the offline trajectory manifold, consistently improving model-based offline RL performance in limited-data settings when combined with trajectory-regularized RL.
